summary: Lolo NF lookout about 10 mi SW of Superior, MT: built 1934 as a 30' pole L-4 tower, a lookout man named in 1935, gone by 1960. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1960 per Firelookout.com; no source we read describes the site today

events.note: Firelookout.com gives 1934 as the build year; an April 1934 Missoulian item (quoted on Forest Lookouts) says materials for ten new lookout towers were ordered, one planned for Wade Peak
September 1935 Missoulian item names Bert Smallwood as a lookout man from Wade Peak
Gone by 1960 per Firelookout.com; the removal date and method are not given

evidence.supports: tower was a 30 ft pole L-4 tower built in 1934; gone by 1960
evidence.quote: This 30' pole L-4 tower, built in 1934, was gone by 1960.

evidence.supports: about ten miles southwest of Superior, Mineral County
April 1934: materials for 10 new lookout towers ordered for the Lolo
evidence.quote: Materials for 10 new lookout towers and observatory building to be placed on the Lolo national forest this spring and summer have been ordered.

evidence.supports: one planned site in the Superior district was Wade Peak
evidence.quote: One location will be: Superior district--Wade peak.

evidence.supports: September 1935: lookout men returning from their posts
evidence.quote: Most of the Lookout men have returned from their posts in the forests.

evidence.supports: September 1935: Bert Smallwood from Wade Peak

sources.title: Wade Peak
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (montanalookouts.weebly.com), quoting The Missoulian, 1934 and 1935

notes_for_editor: Only two web sources, both secondary: Firelookout.com and a Forest Lookouts page quoting Missoulian items from 1934 and 1935. The Missoulian items were checked only as transcribed on Forest Lookouts (April 4, 1934 and September 22, 1935); the originals were not seen. No NHLR or FFLOS record was found. No source describes the site today, so the story makes no access or remains claim. The record's county, agency and location agree with the sources.
